methodology.source: Frozen same-source builds differ only in Game worker concurrency: four vs six. Both use unchanged, identical 18 GLBs.
methodology.execution: Five strictly alternating four/six fresh contexts in one system Chrome process, one locally generated self-signed HTTPS/HTTP2 server, gzip level 6. Browser cache disabled; service workers blocked; 100ms latency, 4Mbps down, 1Mbps up page CDP throttle; CPU not throttled.
methodology.ready: Wall clock from page.goto start to Game ready; host CPU counters and load averages bracket this interval only, with the counters including browser plus any other host work.
methodology.assets: File and pack hashes are verified before sampling; each sample requires 18 status-200 HTTP/2 gzip responses with matching encoded and decoded byte lengths, successful Game ready and no page/GLB failures. No response-body hashing or extra instrumentation occurs during timing.
limitations: This is local representative HTTPS/HTTP2 and gzip, not a production candidate deployment or a physical phone.
TLS certificates are temporary self-signed test certificates, trusted only through the test context's ignoreHTTPSErrors option.
Local gzip output is not guaranteed byte-identical to the CDN's gzip; encoded totals are compared against the recorded production response.
Five paired observations are descriptive; host CPU counters include the browser and external host workloads may affect results.
Service workers are blocked in every sample, so this does not evaluate installation contention or the offline pack.
